title: Empowering Masked Diffusion Models to Self-Correct with Leave-One-Out Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. translated_title: 利用留一变换器赋能掩码扩散模型实现自我纠错
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）已成为一种有前景的语言建模范式，能够以具有竞争力的性能实现并行token生成。然而，标准MDM存在两个根本性局限：（1）无法修改已生成的token，（2）训练信号稀疏。我们重新审视了空心变换器，它通过仅依据周围上下文来预测每个token（独立于该位置自身的输入），从而解决了这两个局限。我们提出了留一变换器（LOOT），这是一种更高效、更具表达力的架构，通过两项互补的进展推进了空心变换器的发展。首先，我们重新设计了合并机制，使左侧与右侧上下文能够频繁交互，相比以往空心变换器大幅提升了预测性能。其次，我们推导出了MDM NELBO的低方差估计器，该估计器能够监督所有token并改善验证困惑度。这些进展共同产生了一个……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出留一变换器（LOOT），通过改进左右上下文合并机制和推导低方差NELBO估计器，赋能掩码扩散模型实现token自我纠错并显著提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), which advances hollow transformers via a redesigned merging mechanism and a lower-variance MDM NELBO estimator, empowering masked diffusion models to self-correct tokens with improved performance.
